title.narrative: Rehabilitation of the Road Corridor Cotonou Niamey Béroubouay Malanville Section (169.4 km)

description.narrative: The overall objective of this project is to promote the integration of the West African Region and trade between Benin, Niger and Burkina Faso, by improving the infrastructure and road transport conditions. In terms of trade and regional integration, the extended area of the project stretches up to Nigeria and Chad
